gaps.title: Missing dedicated 'data' management feature
gaps.jtbd: When cataloging epidemiological records, I want a dedicated structure for managing raw 'data' (datasets, statistics), so that I fulfill the brief's requirement to manage 'данными' explicitly beyond simple files.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given the 'База знаний по эпидемиологии', When managing records, Then there must be dedicated functionality for epidemiological data/datasets distinct from documents and protocols.
gaps.reason: literal brief requirement: The brief explicitly asks to manage 'данными' (data), but the codebase only implements Materials (files) and Protocols, leaving data without dedicated management.

gaps.title: Missing database-backed authentication system
gaps.jtbd: When deploying the epidemiological knowledge base, I want a robust database-backed authentication and authorization mechanism, so that sensitive materials are securely managed by legitimate users without hardcoded credentials.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given a deployed system, When users access the system, Then authentication should be backed by a persistent user database rather than hardcoded in-memory credentials.
gaps.reason: domain-standard expectation: Any knowledge base managing sensitive/medical/epidemiological materials is expected to have a production-ready, database-backed auth system; the current SecurityConfig uses an insecure InMemoryUserDetailsManager.
